**HPI**
Anthony Dimarcello is a 40 y.o. male who presents with rib pain onset 2 weeks ago. The patient was seen here at HHNB on 3/24/2023 for a closed fracture of multiple ribs on his left side due to an E-bike accident where he eloped from the ED. He then returned to the ED on 3/28/23 here at HHNB for SOB where he was also diagnosed with pleural effusion of the left side along with his rib fractures and discharged with a plan to follow up with Nguyen M. Le, MD (Thoracic Surgery). The patient states that his pain today is from this incident but that 2 weeks ago his pain has been increasing. He claims that he has been lifting heavy recently and participating in extraneous activity. He notes associated left dental pain due to impacted wisdom teeth which he feels was made worse by the accident, but denies any falls since the primary incident or recent trauma. He has been taking ibuprofen for pain but states that recently it is no longer providing him with relief.
